title: Correction to: Opaque1 Encodes a Myosin XI Motor Protein That Is Required for Endoplasmic Reticulum Motility and Protein Body Formation in Maize Endosperm
content: This is a correction to Guifeng Wang, Fang Wang, Gang Wang, Fei Wang, Xiaowei Zhang, Mingyu Zhong, Jin Zhang, Dianbin Lin, Yuanping Tang, Zhengkai Xu, Rentao Song, Opaque1 Encodes a Myosin XI Motor Protein That Is Required for Endoplasmic Reticulum Motility and Protein Body Formation in Maize Endosperm, The Plant Cell, Volume 24, Issue 8, August 2012, Pages 3447–3462, https://doi.org/10.1105/tpc.112.101360.
